newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch gold reserves unchanged in week to March 17.
newsitem.headline: Dutch gold reserves unchanged in week to March 17.

text.p: Dutch official gold reserves were unchanged at a book value of 10.869 billion guilders in the week to March 17, central bank data showed.
The Dutch central bank said on January 13 it had sold 300 tonnes of bullion in 1996 and that the transactions as forward sales would not show up in official statistics until February.

The finance ministry holds gold at a book value of 13,900 guilders per kg and since mid-February gold reserves have fallen 4.095 billion guilders from an initial 14.964 billion. That indicates the 300 tonnes has now all been settled.
